models.summary: Tool call passed; long text frequently consumed the budget in reasoning or produced weak non-thinking code.
models.summary_zh_tw: 工具呼叫通過；長文字經常把預算耗在 reasoning，或產生品質較弱的 non-thinking 程式碼。

models.summary: Useful proposals, but output-contract violations and false assurance were observed.
models.summary_zh_tw: 可提供有用提案，但觀察到輸出契約違反與錯誤保證。

models.summary: Native speed and tool use were usable; Rust output had hard API, ownership and async errors.
models.summary_zh_tw: Native 速度與工具使用可用；Rust 輸出存在明確的 API、ownership 與 async 錯誤。

models.summary: Most stable direct general worker in this snapshot; high-risk Rust still requires compiler/test gates.
models.summary_zh_tw: 本快照中最穩定的直接一般 worker；高風險 Rust 仍須 compiler／test gates。

models.summary: 8K/16K fit passed, but no verified quality uplift and about 26% slower than Q4_K_M.
models.summary_zh_tw: 8K／16K 容量通過，但未驗證出品質提升，且比 Q4_K_M 約慢 26%。

models.summary: Current 24GB quality lead; 32K thinking can produce a strong core but still needs adaptive compiler/test repair.
models.summary_zh_tw: 目前 24 GB 級距的品質領先者；32K thinking 可產生強核心，但仍需 adaptive compiler／test repair。

models.summary: Fast generation and acceptable TypeScript, but invalid Tokio repair and a 32K timeout with no final.
models.summary_zh_tw: 生成快速且 TypeScript 可接受，但 Tokio repair 無效，32K 測試逾時且沒有 final。

models.summary: Balanced historical worker with safe 8K capacity; strict JSON and Rust remained unstable.
models.summary_zh_tw: 歷史上較平衡的 worker，8K 容量安全；strict JSON 與 Rust 仍不穩定。

models.summary: Good speed/capacity; reasoning tax can consume the whole final-answer budget.
models.summary_zh_tw: 速度與容量良好；reasoning 成本可能耗盡整個 final-answer 預算。

models.summary: 4K sequential only; 8K failed the 2 GiB headroom gate and repair quality did not beat the 8B model.
models.summary_zh_tw: 僅限 4K sequential；8K 未通過 2 GiB headroom gate，repair 品質也未勝過 8B 模型。

models.summary: Efficiency-first exact checker; P10 achieved 7/10 on the fixed suite.
models.summary_zh_tw: 效率優先的 exact checker；固定 suite 的 P10 為 7／10。

models.summary: Quality-first small checker; P10 achieved 8/10, but a fixed compiler-repair chain degraded a candidate.
models.summary_zh_tw: 品質優先的小型 checker；P10 為 8／10，但固定 compiler-repair chain 曾使 candidate 退化。

models.summary: Fast and small, but only 3/10 exact on the fixed checker contract.
models.summary_zh_tw: 快速且體積小，但固定 checker contract 的 exact 結果只有 3／10。

models.summary: Strong historical daily/RAG lane; fixed Rust judge output contained no-op and incomplete patches.
models.summary_zh_tw: 歷史 daily／RAG lane 表現強；固定 Rust judge 輸出包含 no-op 與不完整 patch。

models.summary: Fast standalone llama.cpp lane; a separate LM Studio structured route was rejected for output-carrier contamination.
models.summary_zh_tw: 獨立 llama.cpp lane 速度快；另一條 LM Studio structured route 因 output-carrier contamination 被拒絕。

models.summary: 25% GPU/75% RAM profile passed the task contract but required roughly four minutes.
models.summary_zh_tw: 25% GPU／75% RAM profile 通過 task contract，但約需四分鐘。

models.summary: Useful reviewer; structured JSON was observed in reasoning_content on one route.
models.summary_zh_tw: 可用的 reviewer；其中一條 route 曾在 reasoning_content 中觀察到 structured JSON。

models.summary: Open-family comparison model; long-context result produced a final with fabricated APIs.
models.summary_zh_tw: 開放模型家族的比較模型；long-context 結果產生了含虛構 API 的 final。

models.summary: Model loaded, but the observed API preset/template produced 400 or empty output.
models.summary_zh_tw: 模型可載入，但觀察到的 API preset／template 產生 HTTP 400 或空輸出。

models.summary: Observed LM Studio backend reported an unknown laguna architecture.
models.summary_zh_tw: 觀察到的 LM Studio backend 回報未知的 laguna architecture。

models.summary: Download completed, but two llama.cpp builds hit tokenizer-load assertions; no quality conclusion.
models.summary_zh_tw: 下載已完成，但兩個 llama.cpp build 都遇到 tokenizer-load assertion；沒有品質結論。

models.summary: Only a partial download existed; integrity, load and quality were not tested.
models.summary_zh_tw: 只有部分下載；完整性、載入與品質均未測試。
